name: notice-board-visit-no-self-v1
description: ⛔ THE HEADLINE CONTROL OF THE WHOLE PASS, AND THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT SUB-ARM IN THE PLAN (Dean, 10/09/2026, §5 of docs/notice-board-visit-handoff-2026-09-10-v2.md). ONE LEAF CHANGES against overlays/notice-board-visit-v1.overlay.json and it is rules.turn.selfVisitAllowed, true to FALSE: you may still play a card onto any Notice Board and take that board's power, but never your own. Everything else is the arm, pinned leaf for leaf, so the pair is attributable to that one rule. THE QUESTION IT ANSWERS: S6 ruled self-use back in, reversing the ban of 04/09/2026, and the argument for it is variety - in v31 every Notice Board printed the SAME thing, so a self-visit was strictly better than a visit (same benefit, no gift, no travel) and it took 22.2% OF TURNS and was banned within two days, whereas here the five boards print five DIFFERENT powers, so your own board is one option of five and it is the one that never has what you have not got. ⭐ THE ARGUMENT HAS A SECOND HALF THAT IS WORTH AS MUCH: a power you can use yourself cannot draw the predecessor's single biggest complaint, the "reverse engine building" cluster of about ten comments in 887, which is my cards only ever fire for my opponents. ⛔ AND IT IS THE THING MOST LIKELY TO SINK THE DESIGN, WHICH IS WHY THE CONTROL EXISTS RATHER THAN AN ARGUMENT. Paying a card to your OWN board is cheaper than paying it to a rival's, because you harvest it back, so a self-visit is a discount as well as an option. HOW TO READ THE PAIR, and this is the decision rule rather than a list of numbers: IF THE ARM AND THIS CONTROL READ THE SAME ON INTERACTION - visits received per player, the visit spread, the bonus rate on the turn measure, game length - THEN SELF-USE IS FREE AND CAN STAY, because it is costing the table nothing. IF THE ARM'S INTERACTION COLLAPSES RELATIVE TO THIS CONTROL, the variety argument of §2.4 is simply wrong, the interaction is decoration and THE DESIGN HAS FAILED IN THE WAY v31 FAILED. Read the self-visit share by seat count in the arm first: it should be worst at two players, where a neighbour's gift is closest to zero-sum, and v31's 22.2% is the only prior number there is. ⚠️ READ TWO SIDE EFFECTS BEFORE CALLING IT: banning self-use makes the bonus SOMETIMES IMPOSSIBLE at two players in a way it never is in the arm (one rival board, one power), which is a structural gate rather than a price and this project has measured twice that a structure rations far harder than a price and charges tempo for the service; and W17 The Pie Shop, O16 The Fruit Store and A17 The Smoke Pot all key on a visit, so their fire rates move with the rule rather than with the design. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors, reference-v15 seeds), paired against the arm on identical seeds. The engine's hand limit of 7 is the simulator's bound and not a rule of the game (C7). ⛔ PINNED AT dairyGrowsBuilt 'none' ON 12/09/2026, WHEN THE BASE MOVED TO 'paidWild'. Every number published off this arm was measured BEFORE Dean ruled the Dairy board's follow-on Grow in, so the pin is what keeps this file reproducing what it measured. A new arm that wants the ruled rule should say so by name. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⚠️ 13/09/2026: rules.economy.noticeBoardsBySeats.2 1 is pinned here because the shipped defaults flipped when the commons was deleted, so this arm stays the game it was. ⛔ APIARY PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the Apiary board's retext in as the shipped default (apiaryPower 'deckGrowWild', "Grow a building using the top card of any deck", the deck card paying any activation cost). This overlay predates it, so apiaryPower is pinned here BY NAME at 'sow' (the S12 Sow 2) and it still replays its own game. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay predates it, so all six leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-ruling values (deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null, meepleSpendDistinctColours false, deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0; 'start' and null are the old inert values, not 'none' and 0) and it still replays its own game. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the coins arm's two sinks, the balloons and the Aerodrome, the Village Store and the closing draw were removed with them. ⚠️ 16/09/2026, THE TOKEN ISLAND AND THE TURN-ORDER RULINGS: the island is now two tokens per tile (Dean, R3: a first delivery pays both demands and chooses its token, a second pays the last token plus 2 any; Workers sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens), and the Vegetable and Dairy boards were retexted (R9, R10), so this overlay's pins of rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice, rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace, rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.dairyGrowsBuilt were removed with the delivery spaces and the Dairy board's Grow. It pins rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.vegetableWildCards 0 and dairyDiscount 0 by name, and island.tokens.workerOnVp [] because its game had no island meeple, and it now starts with seat 0 and gives one more turn each (rules.setup.firstPlayer 'seat0', rules.endGame.endOfGame 'oneMoreTurnEach'). It no longer replays the game it was recorded on, and nothing measured before 16/09/2026 is comparable as a level. ⛔ WHEAT BOARD RETEXT PINNED 19/09/2026: Dean retexted the Wheat Notice Board (sheet v44) to "Harvest one of your buildings, even if it is 1 card short of full", dropped the hand-to-barn rider (wheatBarn 0) and moved the harvest gate from 'loaded' to 'nearFull'. This overlay predates it and V12 The Auction House ("Discard a card from your Barn. Perform the Notice Board action of that crop") reaches the same power as a card effect under ANY visit currency, so both leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-retext values (wheatBarn 1, wheatHarvestGate 'loaded') and it still replays its own game.
